newsitem.title: POLAND: SWARZEDZ TO SELL STAKE TO GERMAN SCHIEDER.
newsitem.headline: SWARZEDZ TO SELL STAKE TO GERMAN SCHIEDER.

text.p: Polish furniture maker Swarzedz SA said on Thursday it had signed a letter of intent on selling five-percent of its planned new issue to German Schieder Group.
Swarzedz said in a statment that the letter, signed on Wednesday, also paved the way for signing a 28-million-mark 3.5-year contract with Schieder to produce bedroom furniture.
"In the letter of intent, the sides declare interest in tightening cooperation. Schieder group declared interest in buying at least five percent of Swarzedz's new share issue," the statement said.
Swarzedz plans to issue 3.125 million shares to creditors and another 3.5 million shares to other investors.
The deal also provides for mutual investment aimed at boosting Swarzedz's production capacity and its modernisation, the statement said.
Swarzedz on Thursday signed an agreement with Schieder's subsidiary, International Moebelhandelskantor Gmbh & Co KH, (IMK) on leasing equipment worth 2.8 million marks.
Last December Swarzedz signed a 200-million-mark contract to supply IMK with furniture.--Warsaw Newsroom +48 22 653 9700
